#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Acceptance test for run-dev-graph-schedule criteria IN1/OUT1/OUT2/OUT3.

Recomputes every assertion from the canonical graph + lease ledger, independently of
schedule-graph.py's own bookkeeping.

usage: c15-acceptance.py <repo_root> <schedule-result.json>
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import subprocess
import sys
from itertools import combinations
from pathlib import Path

PLUGIN_ROOT = Path("/Users/dm/orca/workspaces/harness/ジャーナル作成/plugins/dev-graph")
repo_root = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(strict=True)
result = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
config = json.loads((repo_root / ".dev-graph" / "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
graph = json.loads((repo_root / config["local_state"]["graph"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
by_id = {node["graph_node_id"]: node for node in graph["nodes"]}
done = {node_id for node_id, node in by_id.items() if node["status"] in {"done", "closed"}}
max_parallel = result["max_parallel"]

leases = json.loads(subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, str(PLUGIN_ROOT / "scripts" / "manage-worktree-lease.py"),
     "--repo-root", str(repo_root), "--op", "list"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout)
active_leases = [lease for lease in leases["leases"] if lease.get("state") not in {"released", "expired"}]
leased_ids = {lease.get("graph_node_id") for lease in active_leases}
leased_touches = {value for lease in active_leases for value in lease.get("resource_scope", [])}

ready_features = result["ready_set"]["features"]
ready_tasks = result["ready_set"]["tasks"]
ready_all = ready_features + ready_tasks
findings: list[dict] = []


def check(criterion: str, name: str, ok: bool, evidence) -> None:
    findings.append({"criterion": criterion, "check": name,
                     "status": "PASS" if ok else "FAIL", "evidence": evidence})


def eligible(node: dict) -> bool:
    return (node["status"] == "active" and node["confirmation_status"] == "confirmed"
            and node["evaluation_status"] == "pass"
            and node["implementation_readiness"]["status"] == "complete")


# --- IN1: no ineligible candidate in the ready set -------------------------
bad_state = [node_id for node_id in ready_all if not eligible(by_id[node_id])]
check("IN1", "ready-set に blocked/draft/unconfirmed/evaluation非pass/readiness非complete が0件", not bad_state,
      {"violations": bad_state,
       "ready_state": {node_id: {"status": by_id[node_id]["status"],
                                 "confirmation_status": by_id[node_id]["confirmation_status"],
                                 "evaluation_status": by_id[node_id]["evaluation_status"],
                                 "implementation_readiness": by_id[node_id]["implementation_readiness"]["status"]}
                       for node_id in ready_all}})

expected_excluded = {}
for node_id, node in sorted(by_id.items()):
    reasons = []
    if node["status"] not in {"active"}:
        reasons.append(f"status={node['status']}")
    if node["confirmation_status"] != "confirmed":
        reasons.append(f"confirmation_status={node['confirmation_status']}")
    if node["evaluation_status"] != "pass":
        reasons.append(f"evaluation_status={node['evaluation_status']}")
    if node["implementation_readiness"]["status"] != "complete":
        reasons.append(f"implementation_readiness={node['implementation_readiness']['status']}")
    unmet = [dep for dep in node["depends_on"] if dep not in done]
    if unmet:
        reasons.append(f"unmet_depends_on={unmet}")
    if reasons:
        expected_excluded[node_id] = reasons
leaked = sorted(set(expected_excluded) & set(ready_all))
check("IN1", "除外理由を持つ全ノードが ready-set から除外されている", not leaked,
      {"leaked": leaked, "excluded_with_reasons": expected_excluded})

# --- OUT1: every recommendation has all dependencies done ------------------
unmet = {node_id: [dep for dep in by_id[node_id]["depends_on"] if dep not in done] for node_id in ready_all}
unmet = {k: v for k, v in unmet.items() if v}
check("OUT1", "推薦ノードの全 depends_on が done/closed", not unmet,
      {"violations": unmet,
       "dependency_state": {node_id: {dep: by_id[dep]["status"] for dep in by_id[node_id]["depends_on"]}
                            for node_id in ready_all}})

recomputed = sorted(node_id for node_id, node in by_id.items()
                    if eligible(node) and all(dep in done for dep in node["depends_on"])
                    and node_id not in leased_ids
                    and not (set(node["resource_scope"]) & leased_touches))
check("OUT1", "graph からの独立再計算が ready-set と一致", recomputed == sorted(ready_all),
      {"recomputed": recomputed, "reported": sorted(ready_all)})

# --- OUT2: no resource_scope overlap inside a batch, lease-safe ------------
overlaps = []
for kind in ("features", "tasks"):
    for index, batch in enumerate(result["batches"][kind]):
        for left, right in combinations(batch, 2):
            shared = set(by_id[left]["resource_scope"]) & set(by_id[right]["resource_scope"])
            if shared:
                overlaps.append({"kind": kind, "batch_index": index, "pair": [left, right],
                                 "shared_scope": sorted(shared)})
check("OUT2", "同一 parallel batch 内の resource_scope 重複 pair が0件", not overlaps,
      {"overlapping_pairs": overlaps,
       "batch_scopes": {kind: [{node_id: by_id[node_id]["resource_scope"] for node_id in batch}
                               for batch in result["batches"][kind]] for kind in ("features", "tasks")}})

lease_violations = [node_id for node_id in ready_all
                    if node_id in leased_ids or (set(by_id[node_id]["resource_scope"]) & leased_touches)]
check("OUT2", "active lease と衝突する候補を推薦していない", not lease_violations,
      {"violations": lease_violations, "active_leases": active_leases})

mixed = [index for index, batch in enumerate(result["batches"]["tasks"])
         if any(by_id[node_id]["artifact_kind"] == "feature" for node_id in batch)]
mixed += [index for index, batch in enumerate(result["batches"]["features"])
          if any(by_id[node_id]["artifact_kind"] != "feature" for node_id in batch)]
check("OUT2", "feature ready と task ready が同一 batch に混在していない", not mixed,
      {"mixed_batches": mixed,
       "feature_kinds": [by_id[n]["artifact_kind"] for b in result["batches"]["features"] for n in b],
       "task_kinds": sorted({by_id[n]["artifact_kind"] for b in result["batches"]["tasks"] for n in b})})

flat_tasks = [node_id for batch in result["batches"]["tasks"] for node_id in batch]
flat_features = [node_id for batch in result["batches"]["features"] for node_id in batch]
check("OUT2", "batch 要素集合が ready-set と一致し重複0件",
      sorted(flat_tasks) == sorted(ready_tasks) and sorted(flat_features) == sorted(ready_features)
      and len(flat_tasks) == len(set(flat_tasks)) and len(flat_features) == len(set(flat_features)),
      {"task_batch_members": flat_tasks, "ready_tasks": ready_tasks,
       "feature_batch_members": flat_features, "ready_features": ready_features})

oversized = [batch for kind in ("features", "tasks") for batch in result["batches"][kind]
             if len(batch) > max_parallel]
check("OUT2", f"どの batch も max_parallel={max_parallel} を超えない", not oversized,
      {"oversized": oversized,
       "batch_sizes": {kind: [len(batch) for batch in result["batches"][kind]] for kind in ("features", "tasks")}})

# --- OUT3: unique devgraph/<id> branch + public claim command --------------
assignment = result["assignment"]
branches = [row["suggested_branch"] for row in assignment]
commands = [row["claim_command"] for row in assignment]
naming = [row for row in assignment if row["suggested_branch"] != f"devgraph/{row['graph_node_id']}"]
check("OUT3", "suggested_branch が devgraph/<graph_node_id> 形式", not naming, {"violations": naming})
check("OUT3", "suggested_branch と claim command が一意 (重複0件)",
      len(branches) == len(set(branches)) and len(commands) == len(set(commands)),
      {"branch_count": len(branches), "unique_branches": len(set(branches)),
       "command_count": len(commands), "unique_commands": len(set(commands))})
check("OUT3", "ready task 1件に claim command 1件が対応",
      sorted(row["graph_node_id"] for row in assignment) == sorted(ready_tasks),
      {"assignment_ids": sorted(row["graph_node_id"] for row in assignment), "ready_tasks": sorted(ready_tasks)})
check("OUT3", "claim command が public CLI 形式",
      all(row["claim_command"].startswith("dev-graph worktree claim ") for row in assignment),
      {"commands": commands})

# --- read-only guarantee --------------------------------------------------
check("READONLY", "実行前後の graph/tracker/lease digest が同一", result["digests"]["unchanged"],
      result["digests"])

overall = "PASS" if all(item["status"] == "PASS" for item in findings) else "FAIL"
print(json.dumps({"scenario": "schedule-positive-ready-set", "overall": overall,
                  "checks": findings}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
raise SystemExit(0 if overall == "PASS" else 1)
